'''Scentwine''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage that was purplish in [[Color/Legends|color]]. It had a bright floral aroma. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Toro Irana]] consumed a bottle of it while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]].
